scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @c2pa-demo/shared && npm run build --workspace @c2pa-demo/api && npm run build --workspace @c2pa-demo/web
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @c2pa-demo/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @c2pa-demo/api" "npm run dev --workspace @c2pa-demo/web"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @c2pa-demo/api && npm run test --workspace @c2pa-demo/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @c2pa-demo/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @c2pa-demo/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @c2pa-demo/web
